from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection

# Jet multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 "JetGood" jets
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood", name="4j"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood", name="5j"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood", name="6j"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: exactly 2, at least 3 "BJetGood" b-jets
bjet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood", name="2b"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood", name="3b"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cartesian product of the two binnings -> 3 x 2 = 6 categories
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[jet_multiplicity, bjet_multiplicity],
)
